_comment: Mutation gate (openspec/changes/core-arch design.md §13, task 17.2): the nine targets of the core — src/modules/graph.ts (graph resolution), src/runner/dispatch.ts (the order within a point; §13's src/runner/order.ts), src/config/history.ts, src/determinism/cbor.ts, src/determinism/digest.ts, src/helpers/height-versioned.ts, src/helpers/cursor-table.ts, src/backbone/core-ledger-state/sweep.ts (§13's src/ledger/sweep.ts) and src/backbone/core-block-fetch/node-source.ts (the block fetch queue; §13's src/backbone/block-fetch-queue.ts) — each with its fast tests in vitest.mutation.config.ts (perTest coverage reruns only a mutant's covering tests). 0.9.5's five durability adapters were retired with their parts. break stays at 65 on the aggregate over valid mutants (scripts/mutation-per-adapter.mjs runs one stryker run per target); it ratchets up and MUST NOT be lowered to pass. MEASURED BASELINE 2026-10-27 (task 17.2; npm run test:mutation:ci on a loaded machine, load average 25-45, about 58 min in all): graph 87.81% (837 valid, 1068s), dispatch 95.80% (143, 62s), history 86.10% (597, 37s), cbor 98.18% (603, 494s), digest 96.05% (76, 183s), height-versioned 74.07% (54, 66s), cursor-table 78.38% (37, 59s), sweep 60.62% (325, 42s; 79 mutants no-coverage from its one unit test file), node-source 77.80% (491, 1446s; 121 timeouts) => AGGREGATE 85.33% over 3163 valid mutants (2554 killed, 145 timeout, 373 survived, 91 no coverage).
